dataset: Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates

measure.name: Year-end Treasury par yields by maturity

attribution: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates, year-end 2024 and 2025 observations, accessed 2026-08-10; transformed by ClaimTrace.
limitations: Par yields are not bond prices, realized returns, credit spreads, or an investment recommendation.
Two year-end observations do not characterize within-year volatility or identify causes of curve changes.
The maturities are a declared analytical selection from the official daily curve.
